snippet.title: [Freestyle Football 2] - Official Reveal Trailer @ Gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Freestyle Football 2 is the latest installment from Joycity, offering dynamic 5v5 sports action where each player controls a unique, colorful character to experience the true thrill of football. 
Kicking off in 2026 on Xbox Series X|S, and Playstation 5. 

1 Team Football begins.
⚽ Every move counts.
⚽ Every player matters.
Are you ready to step on the field? 👀
